color.note: Two themes that follow the house: Ditë (day: flowers, coffee, matcha) and Mbrëmje (evening: wine, meze, candles). Switch at 17:00 on screens that know the time.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Day is the pale sage of a florist's wrapping paper; evening is the aubergine of a wine bar after the lamps go on.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the order form, anything that sits on the ground.

tokens.name: ground-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed panels: the menu's price column band, footers, image placeholders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between menu rows. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; meets 3:1 on ground and ground-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, ground-raised and ground-sunk. The mark's stem colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, menu descriptions, hints; on ground, ground-raised and ground-sunk.

tokens.name: matcha
tokens.usage: Daytime brand colour: coffee, matcha, the primary action by day. As text on any ground or matcha-soft.

tokens.name: matcha-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind matcha text: day-part chips, the coffee menu header.

tokens.name: on-matcha
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a matcha fill.

tokens.name: peony
tokens.usage: The flower colour (bozhure, the peony): the bloom in the logo, bouquets, the primary action by evening. As text on any ground or peony-soft.

tokens.name: peony-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind peony text: bouquet tags, the 'Lule me porosi' band.

tokens.name: on-peony
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a peony fill.

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: Evening identity: wine list headers, the evening menu cover, signage after 17:00. As text by day only (on ground). In the evening theme it is a fill, never text.

tokens.name: wine-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds for wine and meze content.

tokens.name: on-wine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a wine fill.

tokens.name: candle
tokens.usage: Small highlights only: 'new', today's sweet, the candle-lit hours. As text on any ground or candle-soft.

tokens.name: candle-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind candle text.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Form errors, always with a written message. Orange-red, kept apart from peony by hue and by the message text.

tokens.name: leaf-lule
tokens.usage: Fill only. The flowers leaf of the clover (top right); flower content in illustrations.

tokens.name: leaf-kafe
tokens.usage: Fill only. The coffee and matcha leaf (bottom right).

tokens.name: leaf-vere
tokens.usage: Fill only. The wine leaf (bottom left). Lighter in the evening so it holds on the aubergine ground.

tokens.name: leaf-embelsira
tokens.usage: Fill only. The sweets leaf (top left), honey.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action. Matcha by day, peony by evening. Alias, so the theme carries the switch.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind primary text.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Gloock, the wordmark's face. Headlines only, sentence case, never below 24px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Signage, posters, the website hero. One per surface.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section titles: menu sections, card titles at large size.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Familjen Grotesk: warm, a little hand-made at the joins, fully Albanian (ë, ç).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Lule të freskëta çdo mëngjes, kafe e matcha gjatë ditës, verë dhe meze në mbrëmje.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Na tregoni për kë është buqeta dhe ne e përgatisim deri në orën 17:00.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Me mjaltë nga Rugova, sipas dëshirës.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and chip labels. Set in caps in the copy, keep it short.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: DM Mono for anything you count: prices, hours, sizes.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices. Euro sign first, two decimals, no space.

styles.name: hours
styles.usage: Opening hours, order cut-offs, dates. 24-hour clock, en dash for ranges.

spacing.note: 4px base. Menus breathe: rows sit space-4 apart, sections space-12.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a name and its description.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; between menu rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on large screens, poster margins.

radius.note: The leaf corner: two opposite corners round (radius-leaf), two stay nearly square (radius-sm). It comes from the leaf in the mark. Buttons and chips are pills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs; the two quiet corners of a leaf shape.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small panels and image thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-leaf
tokens.usage: Top-left and bottom-right corners of cards, photos and packaging labels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the day-part switch.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare. Paper and glass, not plastic.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the bouquet builder sheet.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground gap, then 2px of solid primary (matcha by day, peony by evening). Meets 3:1 on every ground.
